analysis:
Examined the MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift patch and the libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump (889fe3cc to f77b384c). Changes in the engine file: (1) passes modelType into ReasoningPromptProbe.streamingPrefix at head lines ~743 and ~865; (2) constructs the router with streamedCalls: prepared at ~1208, enabling streamed 'auto' tool calls as deltas; (3) adds a streamsToolCalls terminal branch at ~1399-1431 that runs router.finishToolCalls(truncated:), checkNativeToolFailure, ToolConstraintValidation.validate on completedToolCalls, and formatOutput.validate before yielding terminal info, with failures releasing via releaseBox.fire() and finishing with the error; (4) factors terminal usage and timing into yieldTerminalInfo (~1517-1548), preserving matched-answer-stop semantics and cachedPromptTokens from usageSignal.

Security view: no change to encryption, attestation, authorization, cache scope or cacheSalt plumbing (T-041 paths are untouched). The release path (releaseBox.fire) is invoked in both new success and error exits, so reservations are not leaked. The only concern is streamed tool-call deltas leaving before the final whole-set validation. The comment says each call is validated when its frame closed, and a failure at the end terminates the stream with an error. This is a behavioral and correctness trade-off in an output-format path, not a visible confidentiality or authorization regression. Plaintext SSE encryption (T-008) happens downstream and is not altered in the supplied evidence.

Coverage limits: the submodule bump contents (mlx-swift-lm) are not visible, so upstream changes to the parser, router, cache or KV behavior cannot be assessed. The router implementation (streamsToolCalls, finishToolCalls) and the ReasoningPromptProbe signature change are not in the supplied evidence. Integration should check whether those components enforce validation and fail closed, and whether the submodule pin touches the prefix-cache, SSD or encryption code relevant to T-041. The base text of the middle region (lines ~1017-1500) was not supplied, so I reviewed only the patch hunks there.
